inputs.prompt:
Create a 15-second lifelike realistic, photorealistic live-action dark fantasy scene in a very dark candlelit ritual chamber.
The shot begins as a frontal chest-up portrait of the royal Atherian father, facing directly into the screen as if speaking to his sons. The frame shows his full face, shoulders, and part of his chest.
He is an older noble royal Atherian man with:
long white hair
a full white beard
a weathered, regal face
a solemn, loving, sacrificial expression
He has visible blood on:
his face
especially around the eyebrows / brow
parts of the forehead
his hair
his beard
his clothes / robe
The blood should look realistic, messy, naturally smeared, and tragic.
He is wearing visible parts of his blood-stained royal Atherian robe, with realistic dark ceremonial fabric and possibly part of the fur mantle.
Eyes
His eyes are the most important visual element.
They must have an extremely bright teal-green / emerald supernatural glow at maximum intensity.
The glow should feel like 10/10 brightness.
The eyes must:
shine powerfully in the darkness
strongly dominate the frame
remain supernatural and intense
keep a clearly visible black pupil
preserve the natural eye shape and realism
Do not make the eyes a flat solid color.
The eyes should have:
a black pupil in the center
intensely glowing emerald / teal surrounding eye area
strong luminous bloom
bright glow halo
slight greenish spill on nearby skin
Dialogue
The father speaks directly into the screen and says clearly:
“I give my life so you may keep yours. Live, my sons, and finish what I could not.”
He speaks with:
love
sorrow
sacrifice
emotional control
solemn fatherly intensity
His mouth should sync naturally with the words.
Fade behavior — critical
This is the most important correction.
The fade should happen like this:
Stage 1 — opening
At the beginning, we clearly see:
his full face
his beard
his blood
part of his chest and robe
his glowing eyes
Stage 2 — image fades except the eyes
As he continues speaking, the rest of the image gradually fades to black:
his face fades
his beard fades
his hair fades
his clothes fade
the background fades
the candlelit chamber fades
But his glowing eyes do not fade at all during this stage.
His eyes must remain:
fully bright
fully intense
unchanged in brightness
still clearly visible
Eventually, the fade reaches a point where everything is black except his glowing eyes.
This is very important:
There should be a moment where only his glowing eyes are visible against black, while the rest of him is no longer visible.
Stage 3 — hold the eyes only, then final fade
Hold on only the glowing eyes visible against black for a brief moment.
Then, in the last 2 seconds, the eyes themselves finally fade to black.
So the end progression is:
face visible
face fades away
only eyes remain
hold only the eyes
final 2 seconds: eyes fade out
complete black
Lighting
The scene is very dark.
The only illumination at the beginning should come from:
faint candlelight
the glow of his eyes
Do not make the room bright.
Do not add ambient fill light.
Do not add daylight.
Do not add wall glow.
Camera
Use a locked frontal chest-up shot or a very subtle slow push-in.
Do not cut away.
Do not change angle.
Keep the father centered and direct.
Audio
No music.
No narration.
No extra voices.
Use only:
the father’s spoken line
faint candle crackle
subtle room ambience
Critical requirements
15 seconds
starts chest-up, frontal
father talking directly into the screen
blood on face, eyebrows, forehead, hair, beard, and clothes
extremely bright emerald / teal glowing eyes
black pupils clearly visible
face and body fade out first
eyes remain fully bright and unchanged
eventually only the eyes are visible
hold on the eyes alone
last 2 seconds: eyes fade to black
exact line: “I give my life so you may keep yours. Live, my sons, and finish what I could not.”
